text: Bar of limitation: Subject to the provisions contained in sections 4 to 24 (inclusive), every suit instituted, appeal preferred, and application made after the prescribed period shall be dismissed, although limitation has not been set up as a defence.

Article 7: For the recovery of wages of artisans, labourers or household servants not otherwise expressly provided for by this Schedule. Period of limitation: Three years. Time from which period begins to run: When the wages accrue due.

Article 22: For money deposited under an agreement that it shall be payable on demand, including money of a customer in the hands of his banker so payable. Period of limitation: Three years. Time from which period begins to run: When the demand is made.

Article 113: Any suit for which no period of limitation is provided elsewhere in this Schedule (Residuary article). Period of limitation: Three years. Time from which period begins to run: When the right to sue accrues.
